description:
Traditional elegance meets modern functionality in the West Lake Crib. Handcrafted from solid hardwood with a warm Brown Maple finish, this 4-in-1 convertible crib features graceful raised panel detailing and decorative leg cuts that add timeless character to your nursery.

Convert from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size (double) bed as your family grows, making this a lasting investment in your child's comfort. Three adjustable mattress positions keep your baby safe at every stage. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials that meet or exceed all CPSC and ASTM standards.

Coordinates with the full West Lake collection of dressers, chests, nightstands, and accessories for a complete, cohesive nursery.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
